## Orchid UI MCP

Component docs for AI assistants are served only over MCP. Do not rely on a local catalog in consumer apps.

```text
https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/mcp
```

(`https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/api/mcp` is the same handler.)

### Connect

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "orchid-ui": {
      "url": "https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Streamable HTTP. No authentication.

### Tools

1. `list_orchid_components` — search (`search`, optional `category`: `ui` | `components`). Slim list: name, title, description, `install`.
2. `get_orchid_component` — one slug. Full props, examples, files, `install` (`npx shadcn@latest add @orchid/<name>`).

Install via shadcn registry `@orchid` → `https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/{name}.json`.

### Recommended flow

Search → get → run `install` → copy App Studio examples from the tool result. Prefer Orchid components over custom UI.
